text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use is text understanding, which allows machines to find meaning in what we write. NLP also powers translation tools that change text from one language to another quickly. Another example is sentiment analysis, where computers decide if a message is positive, negative, or neutral, which is useful for companies reading customer reviews. Finally, chatbots use NLP to talk with people and answer questions. Thanks to NLP, our daily technology can understand and respond to us in useful ways.
